# Japan place search data

- Source: [GeoNames Japan gazetteer](https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/JP.zip), retrieved 2026-10-28.
- Format: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The local extract contains populated places with population of at least 1,000, administrative seats and prefectures. It retains coordinates, population, native name candidates, romanized names and selected aliases. Native names are selected from the source's Japanese/Chinese-script alternate names. Additional search aliases `西宫`, `钏路` and `kusiro` identify 西宮市 and 釧路市. These are place names for searching, not visited locations or photo records.

Map attribution credits GeoNames. This gazetteer is for place lookup and offline labels. Detailed transport data comes from OpenFreeMap/OpenStreetMap vectors; railway lines and visitor attractions are not fabricated from these points.
